answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake bond before it can trade, with slashing when duplicate behaviour is proven. Like a wharf that charges each vessel a docking deposit, the bond makes mass fake identities expensive: an attacker funding a tide of clones must lock capital for each one, and any delta between claimed and verified activity triggers forfeiture. Honest agents recover their bond, so the cost falls only on Sybils.
